task: Skeptic judge of the finder's 40 level 1 and level 2 candidates of one mechanic under two names, plus level 3 move-ups and extras. The repository was only read.

how_to_read.verdict: same = one mechanic, a card holding both shows the same button or passive twice (a containment, where one entry adds nothing to the other, counts as same). overlap = shares most of the action, each side has a part of its own; card_gets says whether a card holding both gets mostly a repeat, a real second tool, or a coherent pair. distinct = different mechanics.
how_to_read.marking: a = these two variants never on one card; b = the two whole patterns never on one card; c = no marking. 'a, extended' means the variant should be kept off every variant of the other pattern.
how_to_read.can_share_a_card: Checked against the generator rules: a card has one signature (A1, A6), one passive or triggered ability at every tier (tiers max_passive 1, validate.mjs counts every non-key ability), and the classes of both entries must overlap. 'no' means the duplicate cannot happen today whatever the marking.

general_findings: A11 treats a confirmed pair like conflicts_with, which works on whole patterns. Only 3 of my blocks are whole-pattern (L1-01, L2-38, L2-39), and all 3 are already in conflicts_with. Every other block is variant-level: R needs a variant-level list, or a whole-pattern block would also ban many fine pairs (for example all of lay-mines with all of freeze-and-shatter).

4 candidates can never meet on a generated card today: L2-01 and L2-03 (both patterns slot signature), L2-02 (passive plus triggered, one passive slot), L2-14 (no class in common). The finder did not note this for any of them.

Several variants carry another pattern's whole core inside them (be-the-mine and buried-trap burrow by themselves, disguised-bomb is already disguised, blast-spends-user is already a self-destruct, scout-drone is already a reveal). For those, the repeat is against every variant of the other pattern, not one.

A pattern link in requires can force a duplicate: disguise's wolf-in-the-column requires self-destruct (G4), so a self-destruct signature rolled as disguised-bomb gives the same disguised bomb twice (see extra).
